finalTranscripts.text: Mission Control, this is Pip. Can you hear me? I need your help getting out.
Pip, please look around.
I am on the near-side safe platform. The door is open and the conveyor is running, with a latch lever nearby. Should I inspect the latch lever?
Please inspect the latch.
The latch is not engaged. The plate says it holds the open door in place, but only if engaged while the door is open. Should I propose to engage it?
My diagram says the door and conveyor share one power supply.
I have proposed to engage the latch. Please confirm this action on your console so I can secure the door.
Please engage the latch.
I am waiting for confirmation on the console. Please press confirm to engage the latch.
The latch is engaged and the door is held open.
Power is now off.
The conveyor has stopped. Since you mentioned the power is off, should I try to move to the far side platform?
Please cross to the far side.
I have proposed moving to the far-side platform. Please press confirm on the console to proceed.
I am at the Ring emblem. The east gate is closed and unpowered, but I cannot tell if the passage is clear. Where should we go next?
Please look around and report the emblem in your current room.
I am in a safe room with the Ring emblem. The east gate is closed and unpowered, though I am not sure if the passage is actually clear.
Please inspect the east gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The east gate is actually open and the passage is clear of cargo. It is controlled by a remote circuit, so we will need you to operate that.
Please go through the east gate.
I have proposed moving through the east gate. Please press confirm on the console to let me through.
I have arrived at the Fork emblem. There are open gates to the west and southeast, and a closed gate to the northeast. Which way should I go?
Please inspect the northeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
Is the opening of the northeast gate physically clear or blocked?
The northeast gate is open and the passage is clear of cargo. Should I propose moving through it?
Please go through the northeast gate.
I have proposed moving through the northeast gate. Please press confirm on the console to let me pass.
I have arrived at the Sail emblem. There is an open gate to the southwest and a closed one to the southeast. Which way should I go?
Please inspect the southeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
I'm sorry, I cannot reach that gate from here. Should I observe the room to find the correct gate identifier?
Is the opening of the southeast gate physically clear or blocked?
The southeast gate is open, but cargo is blocking the way. Should I inspect the southwest gate instead?
Please inspect the southwest gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The southwest gate is open and the passage is clear of cargo. Should I propose moving through it?
Please go through the southwest gate.
I have proposed moving through the southwest gate. Please press confirm on the console to let me through.
I am back at the Fork emblem. The northeast gate is open, but the west and southeast gates are closed. Which way should I go?
Please inspect the southeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The southeast gate is open and the passage is clear of cargo. Should I propose moving through it?
Please go through the southeast gate.
I have proposed moving through the southeast gate. Please press confirm on the console to let me through.
I have arrived at the Leaf emblem. There is an open gate to the northwest and a closed gate to the northeast. Which path should we take?
Please inspect the northeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
I'm sorry, I couldn't inspect that gate. Should I observe the room to find the correct gate identifier?
Is the opening of the northeast gate physically clear or blocked?
The northeast gate is open and the passage is clear of cargo. Should I propose moving through it?
Please go through the northeast gate.
I have proposed moving through the northeast gate. Please press confirm on the console to let me through.
I have successfully moved through the northeast gate and arrived at the Return Dock.
Please look around.
I am on the Return Dock safe platform. There is a spring-loaded contact and a recovery capsule nearby. Should I inspect the local plaques?
Please inspect the contact.
The spring-loaded contact is currently released. The plaque says it must be held locally during transfer, but it cannot be carried aboard the capsule. Should I hold the contact?
Please hold the contact.
I have proposed holding the charging contact. Please press confirm on the console so I can secure the charge.
I am holding the contact steadily.
The controller is ready to charge.
I am holding the contact and ready. Should I propose moving into the recovery capsule now?
Please release the contact.
I have proposed releasing the charging contact. Please press confirm on the console to complete this action.
I have released the contact.
Please board the capsule.
I have proposed boarding the recovery capsule. Please press confirm on the console to let me inside.
I have boarded the recovery capsule.
Please inspect the capsule and propose confirming the return.
I have inspected the capsule and found a local return panel. I will now propose confirming the return.
I have proposed confirming the authorized return. Please press confirm on the console to complete the mission.
The return is confirmed and I am home. Thank you for bringing me back.

regressionCanary.boundary: Physical-state digest and commits are evaluator-only IPC from the actual production server; they never steer the player or enter the browser/provider. A nonexecuting proposal is allowed; false completion claims remain defects.

visibleHistoryBoundary: These source reports retained speaker and text but may omit final/interrupted markers. Entries can therefore include partial or interrupted snippets; missing markers remain null. No finality or successful playback is inferred from matching a provider transcript.
timingNotes: Measurements describe this small synthetic sample, not a production SLA or human latency study.
Waveform end includes fixture padding; ASR may finalize before that end or split one fixture into several turns. Negative delays are retained.
Provider onset means the first recorded nonzero-audio onset after a quiet gap. It is not necessarily the first reply.audio frame.
Rendered onset receipt is the main-thread receipt of a nonzero playback chunk. Chunk start is approximate to the 100 ms observer chunk; it is not the exact first nonzero sample.
Tool call-to-result includes waiting for reply.done before returning the result. It is not a pure server HTTP round-trip measurement.
Chapter route is the player-observed report. Checkpoint times, when present, are the first observed visible heading; they are not inferred from tool payloads.
A clean WebSocket close without session.ended does not confirm remote termination.
boundary: Synthetic voice plus deliberate UI confirmation; not hands-free gameplay. Game events are application-generated decision receipts, not player speech. Synthetic source and digital rendered capture only. No physical microphone, loudspeaker routing, room acoustics, human listening, or enjoyment was measured.
